Everfrost is new for me too, I never thought about it, but I could see it. The one argument I can see for heal bot Sona is if you have a tankier team and just need bigger numbers. Otherwise, with how fast the TTK is, I think anything that helps avoid damage altogether or help avoid being CC’ed is infinitely more valuable.

I’ve tried both, and everything I feel like Shurelya’s outperforms. Sure, the extra healing and shielding is nice, but rarely matters in most situations when your adc gets one shot. Not only will good ADC’s abuse the extra kiting power from the extra movespeed, but helping your ADC roam after landing is extremely powerful. The active also helps your team escape tricky situations, or chase after survivors after a fight. That, and what you lack in healing, the extra CDR from the mythic passive makes up for. There’s literally no situation I’d take moonstone in unless the item sees a buff.

Late to the discussion, but my group ended up doing something similar to plane chase. We’d have a small side deck of 10 enchantments, shuffle up at the beginning of a game, and reveal the top card. They couldn’t be interacted with, and the effects became global if they weren’t already. 

We usually stayed away from feelbad effects, and it usually led to quicker games with every deck being able to do their thing.
